descriptions.description: Vriesea carinata is a plant species in the genus Vriesea. The bromeliad is endemic to the Atlantic Forest biome (Mata Atlantica Brasileira), located in southeastern Brazil.

Garden cultivars include: Vriesea 'Brachystachys-Splendens' Vriesea 'Cardinalis' Vriesea 'Christiane' Vriesea 'Crimson Glow' Vriesea 'Karamea Tipsy' Vriesea 'Kienastii' Vriesea 'Lucille' Vriesea 'Main Roads' Vriesea 'Mariae' Vriesea 'Marjolein' Vriesea 'Medio-Rosea' Vriesea 'Morreniana' Vriesea 'Nitida' Vriesea 'Pendant' Vriesea 'Pulchella' Vriesea 'Rose Marie' Vriesea 'Saffron Flame' Vriesea 'Serene' Vriesea 'Sweet One' Vriesea 'Tenuis' Vriesea 'Versaillensis' Vriesea 'Witte Senior'
